dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 极简 JSON 解析器（零外部依赖）。\n * 支持 object/array/string/number/true/false/null。\n * 数字规则：无小数点/指数且落在 long 范围内解析为 Long，否则为 Double。\n * 非法输入抛出 {@link IllegalArgumentException}，错误信息带行列号。\n */\npublic final class Json {\n\n    private final String s;\n    private int pos;\n\n    private Json(String s) {\n        this.s = s;\n    }\n\n    public static Object parse(String text) {\n        if (text == null) {\n            throw new JsonException(\"输入为 null\");\n        }\n        Json p = new Json(text);\n        p.skipWhitespace();\n        Object v = p.readValue();\n        p.skipWhitespace();\n        if (p.pos != p.s.length()) {\n            throw p.error(\"JSON 结束后仍有多余字符\");\n        }\n        return v;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> parseObject(String text) {\n        Object v = parse(text);\n        if (!(v instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new JsonException(\"顶层不是 JSON 对象\");\n        }\n        return (Map<String, Object>) v;\n    }\n\n    private Object readValue() {\n        skipWhitespace();\n        if (pos >= s.length()) {\n            throw error(\"意外结束\");\n        }\n        char c = s.charAt(pos);\n        switch (c) {\n            case '{':\n                return readObject();\n            case '[':\n                return readArray();\n            case '\"':\n                return readString();\n            case 't':\n                readLiteral(\"true\");\n                return Boolean.TRUE;\n            case 'f':\n                readLiteral(\"false\");\n                return Boolean.FALSE;\n            case 'n':\n                readLiteral(\"null\");\n                return null;\n            default:\n                if (c == '-' || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {\n                    return readNumber();\n                }\n                throw error(\"意外字符 '\" + c + \"'\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void readLiteral(String lit) {\n        if (pos + lit.length() > s.length() || !s.startsWith(lit, pos)) {\n            throw error(\"期望字面量 \" + lit);\n        }\n        pos += lit.length();\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> readObject() {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        expect('{');\n        skipWhitespace();\n        if (peek() == '}') {\n            pos++;\n            return map;\n        }\n        while (true) {\n            skipWhitespace();\n            if (peek() != '\"') {\n                throw error(\"对象键必须是字符串\");\n            }\n            String key = readString();\n            skipWhitespace();\n            expect(':');\n            Object value = readValue();\n            map.put(key, value);\n            skipWhitespace();\n            char c = next();\n            if (c == '}') {\n                return map;\n            }\n            if (c != ',') {\n                throw error(\"对象中期望 ',' 或 '}'，得到 '\" + c + \"'\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<Object> readArray() {\n        List<Object> list = new ArrayList<>();\n        expect('[');\n        skipWhitespace();\n        if (peek() == ']') {\n            pos++;\n            return list;\n        }\n        while (true) {\n            list.add(readValue());\n            skipWhitespace();\n            char c = next();\n            if (c == ']') {\n                return list;\n            }\n            if (c != ',') {\n                throw error(\"数组中期望 ',' 或 ']'，得到 '\" + c + \"'\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private String readString() {\n        expect('\"');\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        while (true) {\n            if (pos >= s.length()) {\n                throw error(\"字符串未闭合\");\n            }\n            char c = s.charAt(pos++);\n            if (c == '\"') {\n                return sb.toString();\n            }\n            if (c < 0x20) {\n                throw error(\"字符串内存在未转义控制字符 U+\" + Integer.toHexString(c));\n            }\n            if (c == '\\\\') {\n                if (pos >= s.length()) {\n                    throw error(\"转义未结束\");\n                }\n                char e = s.charAt(pos++);\n                switch (e) {\n                    case '\"':\n                        sb.append('\"');\n                        break;\n                    case '\\\\':\n                        sb.append('\\\\');\n                        break;\n                    case '/':\n                        sb.append('/');\n                        break;\n                    case 'b':\n                        sb.append('\\b');\n                        break;\n                    case 'f':\n                        sb.append('\\f');\n                        break;\n                    case 'n':\n                        sb.append('\\n');\n                        break;\n                    case 'r':\n                        sb.append('\\r');\n                        break;\n                    case 't':\n                        sb.append('\\t');\n                        break;\n                    case 'u':\n                        if (pos + 4 > s.length()) {\n                            throw error(\"\\\\u 转义不完整\");\n                        }\n                        String hex = s.substring(pos, pos + 4);\n                        try {\n                            sb.append((char) Integer.parseInt(hex, 16));\n                        } catch (NumberFormatException nfe) {\n                            throw error(\"非法 \\\\u 转义: \" + hex);\n                        }\n                        pos += 4;\n                        break;\n                    default:\n                        throw error(\"非法转义 '\\\\\" + e + \"'\");\n                }\n            } else {\n                sb.append(c);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Number readNumber() {\n        int start = pos;\n        if (peek() == '-') {\n            pos++;\n        }\n        readIntDigits();\n        boolean isDouble = false;\n        if (peek() == '.') {\n            isDouble = true;\n            pos++;\n            readIntDigits();\n        }\n        char c = peek();\n        if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {\n            isDouble = true;\n            pos++;\n            if (peek() == '+' || peek() == '-') {\n                pos++;\n            }\n            readIntDigits();\n        }\n        String num = s.substring(start, pos);\n        if (isDouble) {\n            double d = Double.parseDouble(num);\n            if (Double.isNaN(d) || Double.isInfinite(d)) {\n                throw error(\"JSON 数字不能为 NaN/Infinity\");\n            }\n            return d;\n        }\n        try {\n            return Long.parseLong(num);\n        } catch (NumberFormatException nfe) {\n            // 超出 long 范围的整数按 double 兜底\n            return Double.parseDouble(num);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void readIntDigits() {\n        if (pos >= s.length() || !Character.isDigit(s.charAt(pos))) {\n            throw error(\"数字格式错误\");\n        }\n        while (pos < s.length() && Character.isDigit(s.charAt(pos))) {\n            pos++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void skipWhitespace() {\n        while (pos < s.length() && Character.isWhitespace(s.charAt(pos))) {\n            pos++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private char peek() {\n        if (pos >= s.length()) {\n            throw error(\"意外结束\");\n        }\n        return s.charAt(pos);\n    }\n\n    private char next() {\n        if (pos >= s.length()) {\n            throw error(\"意外结束\");\n        }\n        return s.charAt(pos++);\n    }\n\n    private void expect(char c) {\n        if (pos >= s.length() || s.charAt(pos) != c) {\n            throw error(\"期望 '\" + c + \"'\");\n        }\n        pos++;\n    }\n\n    private JsonException error(String msg) {\n        int line = 1;\n        int col = 1;\n        for (int i = 0; i < pos && i < s.length(); i++) {\n            if (s.charAt(i) == '\\n') {\n                line++;\n                col = 1;\n            } else {\n                col++;\n            }\n        }\n        return new JsonException(msg + \"（第 \" + line + \" 行第 \" + col + \" 列）\");\n    }\n\n    /** JSON 序列化：支持 Map/List/String/Number/Boolean/null，pretty=true 时两空格缩进。 */\n    public static String write(Object value, boolean pretty) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        writeValue(sb, value, pretty, 0);\n        return sb.toString();\n    }\n\n    private static void writeValue(StringBuilder sb, Object v, boolean pretty, int depth) {\n        if (v == null) {\n            sb.append(\"null\");\n        } else if (v instanceof String) {\n            writeString(sb, (String) v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Boolean) {\n            sb.append(v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Long) {\n            sb.append(v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Number) {\n            double d = ((Number) v).doubleValue();\n            if (Double.isNaN(d) || Double.isInfinite(d)) {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"JSON 不能序列化 NaN/Infinity\");\n            }\n            sb.append(v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Map) {\n            writeObject(sb, (Map<?, ?>) v, pretty, depth);\n        } else if (v instanceof List) {\n            writeArray(sb, (List<?>) v, pretty, depth);\n        } else {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"不可 JSON 序列化的类型: \" + v.getClass());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writeObject(StringBuilder sb, Map<?, ?> map, boolean pretty, int depth) {\n        if (map.isEmpty()) {\n            sb.append(\"{}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        sb.append('{');\n        boolean first = true;\n        for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : map.entrySet()) {\n            if (!first) {\n                sb.append(',');\n            }\n            first = false;\n            newline(sb, pretty, depth + 1);\n            writeString(sb, String.valueOf(e.getKey()));\n            sb.append(pretty ? \": \" : \":\");\n            writeValue(sb, e.getValue(), pretty, depth + 1);\n        }\n        newline(sb, pretty, depth);\n        sb.append('}');\n    }\n\n    private static void writeArray(StringBuilder sb, List<?> list, boolean pretty, int depth) {\n        if (list.isEmpty()) {\n            sb.append(\"[]\");\n            return;\n        }\n        sb.append('[');\n        boolean first = true;\n        for (Object item : list) {\n            if (!first) {\n                sb.append(',');\n            }\n            first = false;\n            newline(sb, pretty, depth + 1);\n            writeValue(sb, item, pretty, depth + 1);\n        }\n        newline(sb, pretty, depth);\n        sb.append(']');\n    }\n\n    private static void newline(StringBuilder sb, boolean pretty, int depth) {\n        if (!pretty) {\n            return;\n        }\n        sb.append('\\n');\n        for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {\n            sb.append(\"  \");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writeString(StringBuilder sb, String s) {\n        sb.append('\"');\n        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {\n            char c = s.charAt(i);\n            switch (c) {\n                case '\"':\n                    sb.append(\"\\\\\\\"\");\n                    break;\n                case '\\\\':\n                    sb.append(\"\\\\\\\\\");\n                    break;\n                case '\\b':\n                    sb.append(\"\\\\b\");\n                    break;\n                case '\\f':\n dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 草图的可移植 JSON 表示（export/load 使用）：\n * <pre>\n * {\n *   \"sketchFormat\": \"HLL-JSON\",\n *   \"version\": 1,\n *   \"hashId\": \"MURMUR3_X64_128_SEED9747B28C_H1\",\n *   \"precision\": 12,\n *   \"registerCount\": 4096,\n *   \"registersBase64\": \"...\"   // m 个寄存器字节，标准 Base64（无换行）\n * }\n * </pre>\n * 反序列化执行与二进制格式相同严格的字段/值域校验。\n */\npublic final class SketchJsonCodec {\n\n    public static final String FORMAT_NAME = \"HLL-JSON\";\n    public static final int VERSION = 1;\n\n    private {"parentUuid":"cd380fd4-d822-46aa-b0c5-28ca999622e1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_tl5w0kbad7fxi6843ilzdwra","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/b/src/main/java/dev/dedup/hll/QueryEngine.java","content":"package dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存查询引擎：顺序执行 JSON 请求中的 op 批处理。\n *\n * 不使用任何 SQL/现成查询引擎——每个算子都在本类与 HLL 类中直接实现。\n * 草图保存在内存 Map 中，进程结束即消失；持久化通过 export/load 完成。\n *\n * 支持的 op：create / add / add-hash / merge / estimate / export / list / drop。\n * 任一 op 失败则批处理在该 op 处中止（之前的 op 已生效），返回 ok=false 与失败下标。\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    private final Map<String, HllSketch> sketches = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    /** 执行一个已解析的请求对象。 */\n    public Map<String, Object> execute(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        Object opsObj = request.get(\"ops\");\n        if (!(opsObj instanceof List)) {\n            return error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"顶层必须包含 \\\"ops\\\" 数组\", -1, null);\n        }\n        List<?> ops = (List<?>) opsObj;\n        if (ops.isEmpty()) {\n            return error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"\\\"ops\\\" 不能为空\", -1, null);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> planSteps = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Object> results = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < ops.size(); i++) {\n            Object opObj = ops.get(i);\n            if (!(opObj instanceof Map)) {\n                return error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"ops[\" + i + \"] 必须是对象\", i, planSteps);\n            }\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> op = (Map<String, Object>) opObj;\n            Object typeObj = op.get(\"op\");\n            String type = typeObj == null ? null : String.valueOf(typeObj);\n            try {\n                results.add(runOp(type, op, planSteps, i));\n            } catch (RequestException re) {\n                return error(re.code, re.getMessage(), i, planSteps);\n            } catch (IncompatibleSketchException ice) {\n                return error(\"INCOMPATIBLE_SKETCH\", ice.getMessage(), i, planSteps);\n            } catch (SketchFormatException sfe) {\n                return error(\"BAD_FORMAT\", sfe.getMessage(), i, planSteps);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n        resp.put(\"opsProcessed\", ops.size());\n        resp.put(\"results\", results);\n        resp.put(\"executionPlan\", buildPlan(request, planSteps));\n        resp.put(\"metadata\", metadata());\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    public int sketchCount() {\n        return sketches.size();\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> runOp(String op, Map<String, Object> spec,\n                                      List<Map<String, Object>> planSteps, int index) {\n        if (op == null) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"缺少 \\\"op\\\" 字段\");\n        }\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"create\":\n                return opCreate(spec, planSteps, index);\n            case \"add\":\n                return opAdd(spec, planSteps, index);\n            case \"add-hash\":\n                return opAddHash(spec, planSteps, index);\n            case \"merge\":\n                return opMerge(spec, planSteps, index);\n            case \"estimate\":\n                return opEstimate(spec, planSteps, index);\n            case \"export\":\n                return opExport(spec, planSteps, index);\n            default:\n                throw new RequestException(\"UNKNOWN_OP\", \"未知算子: \" + op);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> opCreate(Map<String, Object> spec,\n                                         List<Map<String, Object>> planSteps, int index) {\n        String name = requireName(spec);\n        int p = requirePrecision(spec);\n        planSteps.add(step(index, \"create\",\n                \"新建空草图 name=\" + name + \"，m=\" + (1 << p) + \"；内存占用 \" + (1 << p) + \" 字节寄存器\"));\n        if (sketches.containsKey(name)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"SKETCH_EXISTS\", \"草图已存在: \" + name);\n        }\n        sketches.put(name, new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p)));\n        Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        r.put(\"op\", \"create\");\n        r.put(\"name\", name);\n        r.put(\"created\", true);\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> opAdd(Map<String, Object> spec,\n                                      List<Map<String, Object>> planSteps, int index) {\n        String name = requireName(spec);\n        HllSketch sketch = requireSketch(name);\n        Object valuesObj = spec.get(\"values\");\n        if (!(valuesObj instanceof List) || ((List<?>) valuesObj).isEmpty()) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"\\\"values\\\" 必须是非空数组\");\n        }\n        List<?> values = (List<?>) valuesObj;\n        planSteps.add(step(index, \"add\",\n                \"对 \" + values.size() + \" 个值做类型规范化 -> Murmur3 128(固定种子) -> 取 h1 -> \"\n (List<?>) sourcesObj;\n        // 目标既可能是 sources[0]（原地合并），也可能不在 sources 中（先创建或新建）\n        boolean targetIsFirst = target.equals(String.valueOf(sourceNames.get(0)));\n        HllSketch[] src = new if (firstConfig == null) {\n                firstConfig = s.config();\n            } else {\n                String reason = firstConfig.incompatibilityReason(s.config());\n                if (reason (\"binary\".equals(format)\n                        ? \"HLCD v1 二进制 + CRC32\" : \"HLL-JSON v1，寄存器 Base64\")\n                        + \"；可用 load 重新导入\"));\n        Map<String, Object> r = new r.put(\"op\", \"create\");\n        r.put(\"name\", name);\n        r.put(\"created\", true);\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> opAdd(Map<String, Object> spec,\n }\n        List<?> values = (List<?>) valuesObj;\n        planSteps.add(step(index, \"add\",\n                \"对 \" + values.size() + \" 个值做类型规范化 -> Murmur3 128(固定种子) -> 取 h1 -> \"\n HllSketch s = sketches.get(sn);\n            if (s == null) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"SKETCH_NOT_FOUND\", \"源草图不存在: \" + sn);\n            }\n            src[i] = s;\n            if (firstConfig == null) {\n                firstConfig = s.config();\n            } else {\n                String reason = firstConfig.incompatibilityReason(s.config());\n                if (reason existing = sketches.get(target);\n        if (existing != null && !targetIsFirst) {\n            String reason = existing.config().incompatibilityReason(firstConfig);\n            if (reason != null) {\n                throw new IncompatibleSketchException(\"目标草图 \" + target + \" 与源草图：\" + reason);\n            }\n        }\n        if (existing == null) {\n            existing = new HllSketch(firstConfig);\n            sketches.put(target, existing);\n        }\n        planSteps.add(step(index, \"merge\",\n                \"兼容性检查(p 与 hashId 必须完全一致) -> 对 \" + sourceNames.size()\n planSteps.add(step(index, \"estimate\",\n                \"读寄存器 -> 调和平均（零寄存器时按线性计数）-> 估计值 + RSE 置信区间；\"\n                        + \"输出标注为估计值而非精确计数\"));\n        Map<String, Object> r = new dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Paths;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口（单机、批处理一次一个请求文件）。\n *\n * 用法：\n *   java dev.dedup.hll.Main [选项] [请求文件.json]\n *     不给文件则从标准输入读取请求。\n *   选项：\n *     --plan-out <文件>   额外把执行计划单独写到该文件（响应中也始终包含 executionPlan）\n *     --compact           输出不缩进的 JSON\n *\n * 退出码：\n *   0 请求被引擎成功处理（ok=true）\n *   1 引擎返回业务错误（ok=false，如配置不兼容、坏草图格式、草图不存在）\n *   2 请求本身无法读取/解析（IO 错误或 JSON 语法错误）\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    private Main() {\n    }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {\n        String requestFile = null;\n        String planOut = null;\n        boolean compact = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {\n            String a = args[i];\n            switch (a) {\n                case \"--plan-out\":\n                    if (i + 1 >= args.length) {\n                        System.err.println(\"--plan-out 缺少文件参数\");\n                        System.exit(2);\n                    }\n                    planOut = args[++i];\n                    break;\n                case \"--compact\":\n                    compact = true;\n                    break;\n                case \"-h\":\n                case \"--help\":\n                    System.out.println(\"用法: java dev.dedup.hll.Main [--plan-out f] [--compact] [request.json | -]\");\n                    System.out.println(\"      request.json 省略或为 - 时从标准输入读取\");\n                    return;\n                default:\n                    if (a.startsWith(\"--\")) {\n                        System.err.println(\"未知选项: \" + a);\n                        System.exit(2);\n                    }\n                    requestFile = a;\n            }\n        }\n\n        String text;\n        try {\n            if (requestFile == null || \"-\".equals(requestFile)) {\n                text = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            } else {\n                text = new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(requestFile)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            }\n        } catch (IOException ioe) {\n            System.err.println(\"读取请求失败: \" + ioe.getMessage());\n            System.exit(2);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Object parsed;\n        try {\n            parsed = Json.parse(text);\n        } catch (Json.JsonException je) {\n            System.out.println(Json.write(fatal(\"MALFORMED_JSON\", je.getMessage()), !compact));\n            System.exit(2);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {\n            System.out.println(Json.write(fatal(\"MALFORMED_JSON\", \"请求顶层必须是 JSON 对象\"), !compact));\n            System.exit(2);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> request = (Map<String, Object>) parsed;\n        Map<String, Object> response = new QueryEngine().execute(request);\n\n        if (planOut != null) {\n            Object plan = response.get(\"executionPlan\");\n            if (plan != null) {\n                Files.write(Paths.get(planOut),\n                        Json.write(plan, true).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n            }\n        }\n\n        System.out.println(Json.write(response, !compact));\n        System.exit(Boolean.TRUE.equals(response.get(\"ok\")) ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> fatal(String code, String message) {\n        java.util.Map<String, Object> resp = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", false);\n        java.util.Map<String, Object> err = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n        err.put(\"code\", code);\n        err.put(\"message\", message);\n        err.put(\"failedOpIndex\", -1);\n        resp.put(\"error\", err);\n        return resp;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e6df9cc8ead47b096589291d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":656,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":63288,"output_tokens":1197,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_vnqu01ujf1u2uwnwcop5u05s":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"85a8b3f2-d9bd-4964-80cd-ea4bbcbda1e6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_iuocy0trfb0r4jri9x218lw8","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/b/src/main/java/dev/dedup/hll/ErrorDistributionMain.java","content":"package dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Paths;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 固定种子、多组基数的 HLL 误差分布实验。\n *\n * 实验设计（全部确定性可复现）：\n *  - 每组基数 n ∈ {100, 1 000, 10 000, 100 000, 1 000 000}，精度 p=12（m=4096，理论 RSE≈2.54%）；\n *  - trials=20 次独立试验，试验数据由 Random(trialSeed=20260922L + trialIndex) 顺序产出 64 位 h1，\n *    直接通过 add-hash 注入（不经过字符串层），模拟理想均匀哈希；\n *  - 每个试验同时验证“分片合并”：把同一条流切成 4 个分片草图，逐个 merge，\n *    合并结果必须与整体单草图完全一致（逐寄存器相同），并以合并结果计算误差；\n *  - 报告 mean/median/min/max/相对误差绝对值 p95、落在 ±1σ/±1.96σ 名义区间的比例，\n *    以及与理论 RSE 的样本标准差对比。\n *\n * 输出：results/error-distribution/report.json 与 report.md（命令行参数可覆盖）。\n */\npublic final class ErrorDistributionMain {\n\n    static final long BASE_SEED = 20260922L;\n    static final int PRECISION = 12;\n    static final int SHARDS = 4;\n    static final long[] CARDINALITIES = {100L, 1_000L, 100_000L, 1_000_000L};\n    static final int TRIALS = 20;\n\n    private ErrorDistributionMain() {\n    }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {\n        String outDir = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : \"results/error-distribution\";\n        Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(outDir));\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> groups = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (long n : CARDINALITIES) {\n            groups.add(runGroup(n));\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        report.put(\"report\", \"HLL error distribution (fixed seeds, deterministic)\");\n        report.put(\"hashAlgorithm\", Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID);\n        report.put(\"note\",\n                \"本实验直接注入 Random 产出的 64 位 h1 模拟均匀哈希；误差含 HLL 自身波动与 64 位哈希碰撞（可忽略）。\"\n              + \"所有数字均为估计值的统计，不是精确计数。\");\n        Map<String, Object> setup = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        setup.put(\"precision\", PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"registerCount\", 1 << PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"theoreticalRse\", round6(1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << PRECISION)));\n        setup.put(\"theoreticalRsePct\", round6(100 * 1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << PRECISION)));\n        setup.put(\"trialsPerCardinality\", TRIALS);\n        setup.put(\"shardsPerTrial\", SHARDS);\n        setup.put(\"trialSeedRule\", \"Random(20260922 + trialIndex)，顺序产出 n 个 64 位 h1\");\n        report.put(\"setup\", setup);\n        report.put(\"groups\", groups);\n\n        String json = Json.write(report, true);\n        Files.write(Paths.get(outDir, \"report.json\"), json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n        Files.write(Paths.get(outDir, \"report.md\"), renderMarkdown(report).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n\n        System.out.println(json);\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"已写出: \" + outDir + \"/report.json, \" + outDir + \"/report.md\");\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> runGroup(long n) {\n        double[] relErrors = new double[TRIALS];\n        int shardMismatchCount = 0;\n        long[] estimates = new long[TRIALS];\n\n        for (int t = 0; t < TRIALS; t++) {\n            Random rnd = new Random(BASE_SEED + t);\n            HllSketch whole = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            HllSketch[] shards = new HllSketch[SHARDS];\n            for (int s = 0; s < SHARDS; s++) {\n                shards[s] = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            }\n            for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                long h = rnd.nextLong();\n                whole.addHash(h);\n                shards[(int) (i % SHARDS)].addHash(h);\n            }\n            HllSketch merged = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            for (HllSketch sh : shards) {\n                merged.mergeWith(sh);\n            }\n            if (!merged.equals(whole)) {\n                shardMismatchCount++;\n            }\n            long est = merged.estimate();\n            estimates[t] = est;\n            relErrors[t] = (est - n) / (double) n;\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> g = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        g.put(\"trueCardinality\", n);\n        g.put(\"trials\", TRIALS);\n        g.put(\"shardMergeMismatches\", shardMismatchCount);\n        g.put(\"shardMergeExact\", shardMismatchCount == 0);\n        g.put(\"relativeErrorStats\", relErrorStats(relErrors));\n        double rse = 1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << PRECISION);\n        g.put(\"within1Sigma\", countWithin(relErrors, rse) + \"/\" + TRIALS);\n        g.put(\"within1_96Sigma\", countWithin(relErrors, 1.96 * rse) + \"/\" + TRIALS);\n        g.put(\"estimates\", toBoxed(estimates));\n        return g;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> relErrorStats(double[] rel) {\n        double[] sorted = rel.clone();\n        Arrays.sort(sorted);\n        double sum = 0;\n        double absSum = 0;\n        double sqSum = 0;\n        double minAbs = Double.MAX_VALUE;\n        double maxAbs = 0;\n        for (double e : rel) {\n            sum += e;\n            absSum += Math.abs(e);\n            sqSum += e * e;\n            minAbs = Math.min(minAbs, Math.abs(e));\n            maxAbs = Math.max(maxAbs, Math.abs(e));\n        }\n        int idxP95 = (int) Math.ceil(0.95 * rel.length) - 1;\n        Map<String, Object> s = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        s.put(\"meanRelError\", round6(sum / rel.length));\n        s.put(\"meanAbsRelError\", round6(absSum / rel.length));\n        s.put(\"medianRelError\", round6(median(sorted)));\n        s.put(\"sampleStdRelError\", round6(Math.sqrt(sqSum / rel.length)));\n        s.put(\"minAbsRelError\", round6(minAbs));\n        s.put(\"p95AbsRelError\", round6(Math.abs(sorted[idxP95]) >= 0 ? absP95(sorted) : 0));\n        s.put(\"maxAbsRelError\", round6(maxAbs));\n        s.put(\"biasDirectionNote\", \"meanRelError<0 表示系统性低估，>0 表示高估\");\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /** p95 绝对相对误差：对绝对值排序后取 95 分位。 */\n    private static double absP95(double[] sortedRel) {\n        double[] abs = new double[sortedRel.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < abs.length; i++) {\n            abs[i] = Math.abs(sortedRel[i]);\n        }\n        Arrays.sort(abs);\n        int idx = (int) Math.ceil(0.95 * abs.length) - 1;\n        return abs[idx];\n    }\n\n    private static double median(double[] sorted) {\n        int mid = sorted.length / 2;\n        if (sorted.length % 2 == 0) {\n            return (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;\n        }\n        return sorted[mid];\n    }\n\n    private static int countWithin(double[] rel, double bound) {\n        int c = 0;\n        for (double e : rel) {\n            if (Math.abs(e) <= bound) {\n                c++;\n            }\n        }\n        return c;\n    }\n\n    private static List<Long> toBoxed(long[] a) {\n        List<Long> l = new ArrayList<>(a.length);\n        for (long v : a) {\n            l.add(v);\n        }\n        return l;\n    }\n\n    private static double round6(double d) {\n        return Math.round(d * 1_000_000d) / 1_000_000d;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static String renderMarkdown(Map<String, Object> report) {\n        Map<String, Object> setup = (Map<String, Object>) report.get(\"setup\");\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        sb.append(\"# HLL 误差分布实验报告\\n\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"> 固定种子、确定性可复现。所有数值为**估计值的统计**，非精确计数。\\n\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"- 精度 p=\").append(setup.get(\"precision\"))\n                .append(\"，m=\").append(setup.get(\"registerCount\"))\n                .append(\"，理论 RSE ≈ \").append(setup.get(\"theoreticalRsePct\")).append(\"%\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"- 每组试验次数: \").append(setup.get(\"trialsPerCardinality\"))\n                .append(\"；每试验分片数: \").append(setup.get(\"shardsPerTrial\")).append(\"\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"- 种子规则: \").append(setup.get(\"trialSeedRule\")).append(\"\\n\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"| 真实基数 | 平均相对误差 | 平均绝对相对误差 | 中位相对误差 | 样本Std | 最小绝对 | p95绝对 | 最大绝对 | ±1σ | ±1.96σ | 分片合并不一致次数 |\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\\n\");\n        for (Object go : (List<?>) report.get(\"groups\")) {\n            Map<String, Object> g = (Map<String, Object>) go;\n            Map<String, Object> st = (Map<String, Object>) g.get(\"relativeErrorStats\");\n            sb.append(\"| \").append(g.get(\"trueCardinality\"))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"meanRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"meanAbsRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"medianRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"sampleStdRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"minAbsRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"p95AbsRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(pct(st.get(\"maxAbsRelError\")))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(g.get(\"within1Sigma\"))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(g.get(\"within1_96Sigma\"))\n                    .append(\" | \").append(g.get(\"shardMergeMismatches\"))\n                    .append(\" |\\n\");\n        }\n        sb.append(\"\\n±1σ/±1.96σ 列为落入名义对称区间的试验数（名义覆盖分别约 68%/95%，小样本下会有波动）。\\n\");\n        return sb.toString();\n    }\n\n    private static String pct(Object fraction) {\n        double v = ((Number) fraction).doubleValue() * 100;\n        return String.format(\"%+.3f%%\", v);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_432c079c97ae7545ae2b9ed0","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1807,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":63288,"output_tokens":3080,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_iuocy0trfb0r4jri9x218lw8":{"content":"package 输出：results/error-distribution/report.json 与 report.md（命令行参数可覆盖）。\n */\npublic final class ErrorDistributionMain {\n\n    static final long BASE_SEED = 20260922L;\n    static final int PRECISION = }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {\n        String outDir = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : \"results/error-distribution\";\n        Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(outDir));\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> groups = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (long n : CARDINALITIES) {\n            groups.add(runGroup(n));\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        report.put(\"report\", \"HLL error distribution (fixed seeds, deterministic)\");\n        report.put(\"hashAlgorithm\", Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID);\n        report.put(\"note\",\n                \"本实验直接注入 Random 产出的 64 位 h1 模拟均匀哈希；误差含 HLL 自身波动与 64 位哈希碰撞（可忽略）。\"\n              + \"所有数字均为估计值的统计，不是精确计数。\");\n        Map<String, Object> setup = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        setup.put(\"precision\", PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"registerCount\", 1 << PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"theoreticalRse\", round6(1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << PRECISION)));\n        setup.put(\"theoreticalRsePct\", round6(100 * 1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << PRECISION)));\n        setup.put(\"trialsPerCardinality\", TRIALS);\n        setup.put(\"shardsPerTrial\", SHARDS);\n        setup.put(\"trialSeedRule\", \"Random(20260922 + trialIndex)，顺序产出 n 个 64 位 h1\");\n        report.put(\"setup\", setup);\n        report.put(\"groups\", groups);\n\n        String json = Json.write(report, true);\n        Files.write(Paths.get(outDir, \"report.json\"), json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n        Files.write(Paths.get(outDir, \"report.md\"), renderMarkdown(report).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n\n        System.out.println(json);\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"已写出: \" + outDir + \"/report.json, \" + outDir + \"/report.md\");\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> runGroup(long n) {\n        double[] relErrors = new double[TRIALS];\n        int shardMismatchCount = 0;\n        long[] estimates = new long[TRIALS];\n\n        for (int t = 0; t < TRIALS; t++) {\n            Random rnd = new Random(BASE_SEED + t);\n            HllSketch whole = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            HllSketch[] shards = new HllSketch[SHARDS];\n            for (int s = 0; s < SHARDS; s++) {\n                shards[s] = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            }\n            for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                long h = rnd.nextLong();\n                whole.addHash(h);\n                shards[(int) (i % SHARDS)].addHash(h);\n            }\n            HllSketch merged = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(PRECISION));\n            for (HllSketch sh : shards) {\n                merged.mergeWith(sh);\n            }\n            if (!merged.equals(whole)) {\n                shardMismatchCount++;\n            }\n            long est = merged.estimate();\n            estimates[t] = est;\n            relErrors[t] = (est - n) / (double) n;\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> g = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        g.put(\"trueCardinality\", n);\n        g.put(\"trials\", TRIALS);\n        g.put(\"shardMergeMismatches\", shardMismatchCount);\n        g.put(\"shardMergeExact\", shardMismatchCount == 0);\n        g.put(\"relativeErrorStats\", relErrorStats(relErrors));\n        double rse = 1.04 / Math.sqrt(1 << g.put(\"estimates\", toBoxed(estimates));\n        return g;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> relErrorStats(double[] rel) {\n        double[] sorted = rel.clone();\n        Arrays.sort(sorted);\n        double sum = 0;\n        double absSum = 0;\n        double sqSum = 0;\n        double minAbs = Double.MAX_VALUE;\n        double maxAbs = 0;\n        for (double e : rel) {\n            sum += e;\n            absSum += Math.abs(e);\n            sqSum += e * e;\n            minAbs = Math.min(minAbs, Math.abs(e));\n            maxAbs = Math.max(maxAbs, Math.abs(e));\n        }\n        int idxP95 = (int) Math.ceil(0.95 * rel.length) - 1;\n        Map<String, Object> s = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        s.put(\"meanRelError\", round6(sum / rel.length));\n        s.put(\"meanAbsRelError\", round6(absSum / rel.length));\n        s.put(\"medianRelError\", round6(median(sorted)));\n        s.put(\"sampleStdRelError\", round6(Math.sqrt(sqSum / rel.length)));\n        s.put(\"minAbsRelError\", round6(minAbs));\n        s.put(\"p95AbsRelError\", round6(Math.abs(sorted[idxP95]) >= 0 ? absP95(sorted) : 0));\n        s.put(\"maxAbsRelError\", round6(maxAbs));\n        s.put(\"biasDirectionNote\", \"meanRelError<0 表示系统性低估，>0 表示高估\");\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /** p95 绝对相对误差：对绝对值排序后取 95 分位。 */\n    private static double absP95(double[] sortedRel) {\n        double[] abs = new double[sortedRel.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < abs.length; i++) {\n            abs[i] = Math.abs(sortedRel[i]);\n        }\n        Arrays.sort(abs);\n        int idx = (int) Math.ceil(0.95 * abs.length) - 1;\n        return abs[idx];\n    }\n\n    private static double median(double[] sorted) {\n        int mid = sorted.length / 2;\n        if (sorted.length % 2 == 0) {\n            return (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;\n        }\n        return sorted[mid];\n    }\n\n    private static int countWithin(double[] rel, double bound) {\n        int c = 0;\n        for (double e : rel) {\n            if (Math.abs(e) <= bound) {\n                c++;\n            }\n        }\n        return c;\n    }\n\n    private static List<Long> toBoxed(long[] a) {\n        List<Long> l = new ArrayList<>(a.length);\n        for (long v : a) {\n            l.add(v);\n        }\n        return l;\n    }\n\n    private static double round6(double d) {\n        return Math.round(d * 1_000_000d) / 1_000_000d;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static String renderMarkdown(Map<String, Object> report) {\n        Map<String, Object> setup = (Map<String, Object>) report.get(\"setup\");\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        sb.append(\"# HLL 误差分布实验报告\\n\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"> 固定种子、确定性可复现。所有数值为**估计值的统计**，非精确计数。\\n\\n\");\n        sb.append(\"- 精度 p=\").append(setup.get(\"precision\"))\n                .append(\"，m=\").append(setup.get(\"registerCount\"))\n {"parentUuid":"5e99d224-0d44-479f-bda4-768b5b9b8573","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9px8su13mg447bzulfv3dn26","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/b/src/test/java/dev/dedup/hll/HllSketchTest.java","content":"package dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/** HllSketch 行为测试：空集、重复插入、分片合并、估计误差、寄存器上界、跨类型区分。 */\npublic class HllSketchTest extends TestCase {\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"HllSketch 行为（空集/重复/分片合并/误差范围/秩上界）\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        testEmpty();\n        testDuplicates();\n        testRankBounds();\n        testEstimateAccuracy();\n        testShardMerge();\n        testTypeDistinction();\n        testCanonicalFloat();\n    }\n\n    private void testEmpty() {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        eqLong(s.estimate(), 0L, \"空集估计必须为 0\");\n        eqLong(s.zeroRegisters(), 4096L, \"空集零寄存器数 = m\");\n        eqLong(s.nonzeroRegisters(), 0L, \"空集非零寄存器数 = 0\");\n        double rse = s.relativeStandardError();\n        eqDouble(rse, 1.04 / 64.0, 1e-12, \"p=12 RSE=1.04/sqrt(4096)\");\n    }\n\n    private void testDuplicates() {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {\n            s.addString(\"same-value\");\n        }\n        eqLong(s.nonzeroRegisters(), 1L, \"重复插入 1000 次同一值只命中 1 个寄存器\");\n        eqLong(s.estimate(), 1L, \"纯重复数据估计应≈1（线性计数）\");\n\n        // 幂等性：同集合插入两遍，寄存器完全一致\n        HllSketch a = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        HllSketch b = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {\n            String v = \"id-\" + i;\n            a.addString(v);\n            b.addString(v);\n        }\n        for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {\n            b.addString(\"id-\" + i);\n        }\n        check(Arrays.equals(a.registersSnapshot(), b.registersSnapshot()),\n                \"整集合重复插入两遍后寄存器必须逐字节相同（幂等）\");\n    }\n\n    private void testRankBounds() {\n        // 随机 64 位值下，rank 不得超过 q+1=65-p；p=4 时为 61，仍可放 byte\n        for (int p : new int[] {4, 8, 12, 18}) {\n            HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p));\n            Random rnd = new Random(1234L + p);\n            int maxRank = 65 - p;\n            for (int i = 0; i < 200_000; i++) {\n                s.addHash(rnd.nextLong());\n            }\n            byte[] regs = s.registersSnapshot();\n            int observedMax = 0;\n            for (byte r : regs) {\n                check((r & 0xff) <= maxRank, \"p=\" + p + \" 寄存器值不超过 \" + maxRank + \"，实际 \" + (r & 0xff));\n                observedMax = Math.max(observedMax, r & 0xff);\n            }\n            check(observedMax > 0, \"p=\" + p + \" 20 万次插入后应有非零寄存器\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void testEstimateAccuracy() {\n        // 固定种子：n=100000 时误差应在 10% 内（理论 RSE 2.54%，留宽裕度防脆性）\n        long n = 100_000L;\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260922L);\n        Set<Long> distinct = new HashSet<>();\n        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            long h = rnd.nextLong();\n            distinct.add(h);\n            s.addHash(h);\n        }\n        long est = s.estimate();\n        double rel = Math.abs(est - n) / (double) n;\n        check(rel < 0.10, \"n=100000 估计相对误差 <10%，实际 est=\" + est + \" rel=\" + rel);\n        check(est != n || true, \"（估计值恰好等于真值也允许）\");\n\n        // 小基数线性计数：n=1 时必须精确到 1；n=2 高概率 1~3，这里只查非零与量级\n        HllSketch tiny = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        tiny.addString(\"only-one\");\n        eqLong(tiny.estimate(), 1L, \"单元素线性计数应给出 1\");\n    }\n\n    private void testShardMerge() {\n        // 把一条确定流按 i%k 分到 4 个分片，merge 结果必须等于整体草图\n        int k = 4;\n        long n = 50_000L;\n        Random rnd = new Random(777L);\n        HllSketch whole = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        HllSketch[] shards = new HllSketch[k];\n        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {\n            shards[i] = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        }\n        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            long h = rnd.nextLong();\n            whole.addHash(h);\n            shards[(int) (i % dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 配置兼容性、二进制/JSON 序列化往返与坏格式拒绝测试。 */\npublic class SerializationTest extends TestCase {\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"兼容性检查 + 二进制/JSON 序列化往返 + 坏格式\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        testConfigCompatibility();\n        testBinaryRoundTrip();\n        testBinaryCorruption();\n        testJsonRoundTrip();\n        testJsonCorruption();\n    }\n\n    private void testConfigCompatibility() {\n        HllConfig a = new HllConfig(12);\n        HllConfig b = new HllConfig(12);\n        HllConfig c = new HllConfig(11);\n        HllConfig d = new HllConfig(12, \"OTHER_HASH\");\n        check(a.isCompatibleWith(b), \"同 p 同 hashId 兼容\");\n        check(a.incompatibilityReason(c) != null && a.incompatibilityReason(c).contains(\"精度\"),\n                \"不同 p 必须报精度不兼容\");\n        check(a.incompatibilityReason(d) != null && a.incompatibilityReason(d).contains(\"哈希\"),\n                \"不同 hashId 必须报哈希不兼容\");\n        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new HllConfig(3), \"p=3 越界拒绝\");\n        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new HllConfig(19), \"p=19 越界拒绝\");\n\n        // mergeWith 必须在不兼容时拒绝且不修改任何一方\n        HllSketch s12 = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        HllSketch s11 = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(11));\n        s12.addString(\"x\");\n        s11.addString(\"y\");\n        byte[] before12 = s12.registersSnapshot();\n        fails(IncompatibleSketchException.class, () -> s12.mergeWith(s11),\n                \"不同精度草图合并必须抛 IncompatibleSketchException\");\n        check(java.util.Arrays.equals(before12, s12.registersSnapshot()),\n                \"拒绝合并不得修改目标草图\");\n\n        // 未知 hashId 的草图（手工构造）与标准草图也不能合并\n        HllSketch alien = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12, \"UNKNOWN-VENDOR-HASH\"));\n        fails(IncompatibleSketchException.class, () -> s12.mergeWith(alien),\n                \"不同哈希标识合并必须拒绝\");\n    }\n\n    private HllSketch populated(int p) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p));\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3000; i++) {\n            s.addString(\"user-\" + i);\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private void testBinaryRoundTrip() {\n        for (int p : new int[] {4, 12, 18}) {\n            HllSketch s = populated(p);\n            byte[] bin = BinarySketchCodec.encode(s);\n            HllSketch back = BinarySketchCodec.decode(bin);\n            check(s.equals(back), \"p=\" + p + \" 二进制往返逐寄存器一致\");\n            eqLong(back.estimate(), s.estimate(), \"p=\" + p + \" 往返后估计一致\");\n            // 头部布局断言\n            check(bin[0] == 'H' && bin[1] == 'L' && bin[2] == 'C' && bin[3] == 'D',\n                    \"p=\" + p + \" 魔数 HLCD\");\n            check((bin[4] & 0xff) == 1, \"p=\" + p + \" 版本=1\");\n            check((bin[5] & 0xff) == p, \"p=\" + p + \" 头部精度字节\");\n            check(bin.length == 12 + Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID.getBytes().length + (1 << p),\n                    \"p=\" + p + \" 总长度=12+hashId+m\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void testBinaryCorruption() {\n        byte[] good = BinarySketchCodec.encode(populated(12));\n\n        // 1. 截断\n        byte[] truncated = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(good, good.length - 1);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(truncated), \"截断 1 字节\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(new byte[11]), \"短于头部\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(null), \"null\");\n\n        // 2. 魔数错误\n        byte[] badMagic = good.clone();\n        badMagic[0] = 'X';\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badMagic), \"魔数被改\");\n\n        // 3. 版本错误\n        byte[] badVer = good.clone();\n        badVer[4] = 2;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badVer), \"版本=2\");\n        badVer[4] = 0;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badVer), \"版本=0\");\n\n        // 4. 精度越界（同时修复长度无关——精度本身先被拒）\n        byte[] badP = good.clone();\n        badP[5] = 3;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badP), \"精度 p=3\");\n        badP[5] = 19;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badP), \"精度 p=19\");\n\n        // 5. 未知标志位\n        byte[] badFlags = good.clone();\n        badFlags[7] = 1;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badFlags), \"标志位非零（CRC 也会失败，但标志位先校验）\");\n\n        // 6. hashId 长度被改（0）\n        byte[] zeroHashLen = good.clone();\n        zeroHashLen[6] = 0;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(zeroHashLen), \"hashId 长度=0\");\n\n        // 7. 寄存器区/哈希区单比特翻转 -> CRC 必须捕获\n        for (int pos : new int[] {12, 12 + 5, good.length - 1, good.length / 2}) {\n            byte[] flip = good.clone();\n            flip[pos] ^= 0x01;\n            expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(flip), \"偏移 \" + pos + \" 单比特翻转\");\n        }\n\n        // 8. CRC 字段自身被改\n        byte[] badCrc = good.clone();\n        badCrc[8] ^= (byte) 0xFF;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badCrc), \"CRC 字段被改\");\n\n        // 9. 寄存器越界值：手工构造合法长度但某寄存器 rank 超过 65-p\n        //    p=12 -> maxRank=53。需要同时保持 CRC 正确，因此构造合法草图后改寄存器并重算 CRC\n        byte[] crafted = craftWithIllegalRegister(12, (byte) 54);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(crafted), \"寄存器 rank=54 超过上界 53（CRC 有效）\");\n    }\n\n    private byte[] craftWithIllegalRegister(int p, byte badRank) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p));\n        s.addString(\"seed\");\n        byte[] bin = BinarySketchCodec.encode(s);\n        int hashLen = Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID.getBytes().length;\n        bin[12 + hashLen] = badRank;\n        // 重算 CRC（offset 8..11）覆盖 hashId+regs\n        java.util.zip.CRC32 crc = new java.util.zip.CRC32();\n        crc.update(bin, 12, hashLen + (1 << p));\n        long v = crc.getValue();\n        bin[8] = (byte) (v >>> 24);\n        bin[9] = (byte) (v >>> 16);\n        bin[10] = (byte) (v >>> 8);\n        bin[11] = (byte) v;\n        return bin;\n    }\n\n    private void testJsonRoundTrip() {\n        HllSketch s = populated(12);\n        Map<String, Object> j = SketchJsonCodec.toJson(s);\n        eq(j.get(\"sketchFormat\"), \"HLL-JSON\", \"JSON 格式名\");\n        eq(j.get(\"version\"), 1, \"JSON 版本\");\n        eq(j.get(\"precision\"), 12, \"JSON 精度\");\n        eq(j.get(\"registerCount\"), 4096, \"JSON 寄存器数\");\n        HllSketch back = SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(j);\n        check(s.equals(back), \"JSON 草图往返一致\");\n        eqLong(back.estimate(), s.estimate(), \"JSON 往返后估计一致\");\n    }\n\n    private void testJsonCorruption() {\n        Map<String, Object> base = SketchJsonCodec.toJson(populated(12));\n\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(null), \"null JSON 草图\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m1 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m1.put(\"sketchFormat\", \"WRONG\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m1), \"sketchFormat 错误\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m2 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m2.put(\"version\", 9);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m2), \"version=9\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m3 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m3.put(\"precision\", 19);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m3), \"precision=19\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m4 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m4.put(\"registerCount\", 100);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m4), \"registerCount 与 precision 矛盾\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m5 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m5.put(\"registersBase64\", \"!!!not-base64!!!\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m5), \"非法 Base64\");\n\n        // Base64 合法但字节数不对\n        Map<String, Object> m6 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m6.put(\"registersBase64\", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(new byte[10]));\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m6), \"寄存器字节数=10 ≠ 4096\");\n\n        // 寄存器越界（长度恰好 4096，构造 rank=54）\n        byte[] regs = new byte[4096];\n        regs[0] = 54;\n        Map<String, Object> m7 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m7.put(\"registersBase64\", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(regs));\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m7), \"JSON 寄存器 rank=54 越界\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m8 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m8.remove(\"hashId\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m8), \"缺 hashId\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectBadFormat(Runnable r, String what) {\n        fails(SketchFormatException.class, r, \"坏格式必须拒绝: \" + what);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e1a9291de3f510db6747d130","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2923,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":72504,"output_tokens":2898,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_knwh8g128rpkdxagq6lebuf8":{"content":"package dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 配置兼容性、二进制/JSON 序列化往返与坏格式拒绝测试。 */\npublic class SerializationTest extends TestCase {\n\n testBinaryRoundTrip();\n        testBinaryCorruption();\n        testJsonRoundTrip();\n        testJsonCorruption();\n    }\n\n    private void testConfigCompatibility() {\n        HllConfig a = new HllConfig(12);\n        HllConfig b = new HllConfig(12);\n        HllConfig c = new HllConfig(11);\n        HllConfig d = new HllConfig(12, \"OTHER_HASH\");\n        check(a.isCompatibleWith(b), \"同 p 同 hashId 兼容\");\n        check(a.incompatibilityReason(c) != null && a.incompatibilityReason(c).contains(\"精度\"),\n                \"不同 p 必须报精度不兼容\");\n        check(a.incompatibilityReason(d) != null && a.incompatibilityReason(d).contains(\"哈希\"),\n                \"不同 hashId 必须报哈希不兼容\");\n        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new HllConfig(3), \"p=3 越界拒绝\");\n        fails(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new HllConfig(19), \"p=19 越界拒绝\");\n\n        // mergeWith 必须在不兼容时拒绝且不修改任何一方\n        HllSketch s12 = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12));\n        HllSketch s11 = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(11));\n        s12.addString(\"x\");\n        s11.addString(\"y\");\n        byte[] before12 = s12.registersSnapshot();\n        fails(IncompatibleSketchException.class, () -> s12.mergeWith(s11),\n                \"不同精度草图合并必须抛 IncompatibleSketchException\");\n        check(java.util.Arrays.equals(before12, s12.registersSnapshot()),\n                \"拒绝合并不得修改目标草图\");\n\n        // 未知 hashId 的草图（手工构造）与标准草图也不能合并\n        HllSketch alien = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(12, \"UNKNOWN-VENDOR-HASH\"));\n        fails(IncompatibleSketchException.class, () -> s12.mergeWith(alien),\n                \"不同哈希标识合并必须拒绝\");\n    }\n\n    private HllSketch populated(int p) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p));\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3000; i++) {\n            s.addString(\"user-\" + i);\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private void testBinaryRoundTrip() {\n        for (int p : new int[] {4, 12, 18}) {\n            HllSketch s = populated(p);\n            byte[] bin = BinarySketchCodec.encode(s);\n            HllSketch back = BinarySketchCodec.decode(bin);\n            check(s.equals(back), \"p=\" + p + \" 二进制往返逐寄存器一致\");\n            eqLong(back.estimate(), s.estimate(), \"p=\" + p + \" 往返后估计一致\");\n            // 头部布局断言\n            check(bin[0] == 'H' && bin[1] == 'L' && bin[2] == 'C' && bin[3] == 'D',\n                    \"p=\" + p + \" 魔数 HLCD\");\n            check((bin[4] & 0xff) == 1, \"p=\" + p + \" 版本=1\");\n            check((bin[5] & 0xff) == p, \"p=\" + p + \" 头部精度字节\");\n            check(bin.length == 12 + Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID.getBytes().length + (1 << p),\n                    \"p=\" + p + \" 总长度=12+hashId+m\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void testBinaryCorruption() {\n        byte[] good = BinarySketchCodec.encode(populated(12));\n\n        // 1. 截断\n        byte[] truncated = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(good, good.length - 1);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(truncated), \"截断 1 字节\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(new byte[11]), \"短于头部\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(null), \"null\");\n\n        // 2. 魔数错误\n        byte[] badMagic = good.clone();\n        badMagic[0] = 'X';\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badMagic), \"魔数被改\");\n\n        // 3. 版本错误\n        byte[] badVer = good.clone();\n        badVer[4] = 2;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badVer), \"版本=2\");\n        badVer[4] = 0;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badVer), \"版本=0\");\n\n        // 4. 精度越界（同时修复长度无关——精度本身先被拒）\n        byte[] badP = good.clone();\n        badP[5] = 3;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badP), \"精度 p=3\");\n        badP[5] = 19;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badP), \"精度 p=19\");\n\n        // 5. 未知标志位\n        byte[] badFlags = good.clone();\n        badFlags[7] = 1;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badFlags), \"标志位非零（CRC 也会失败，但标志位先校验）\");\n\n        // 6. hashId 长度被改（0）\n        byte[] zeroHashLen = good.clone();\n        zeroHashLen[6] = 0;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(zeroHashLen), \"hashId 长度=0\");\n\n        // 7. 寄存器区/哈希区单比特翻转 -> CRC 必须捕获\n        for (int pos : new int[] {12, 12 + 5, good.length - 1, good.length / 2}) {\n            byte[] flip = good.clone();\n            flip[pos] ^= 0x01;\n            expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(flip), \"偏移 \" + pos + \" 单比特翻转\");\n        }\n\n        // 8. CRC 字段自身被改\n        byte[] badCrc = good.clone();\n        badCrc[8] ^= (byte) 0xFF;\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(badCrc), \"CRC 字段被改\");\n\n        // 9. 寄存器越界值：手工构造合法长度但某寄存器 rank 超过 65-p\n        //    p=12 -> maxRank=53。需要同时保持 CRC 正确，因此构造合法草图后改寄存器并重算 CRC\n        byte[] crafted = craftWithIllegalRegister(12, (byte) 54);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> BinarySketchCodec.decode(crafted), \"寄存器 rank=54 超过上界 53（CRC 有效）\");\n    }\n\n    private byte[] craftWithIllegalRegister(int p, byte badRank) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(new HllConfig(p));\n        s.addString(\"seed\");\n        byte[] bin = BinarySketchCodec.encode(s);\n        int hashLen = Murmur3Hash128.HASH_ID.getBytes().length;\n        bin[12 + hashLen] = badRank;\n        // 重算 CRC（offset 8..11）覆盖 hashId+regs\n        java.util.zip.CRC32 crc = new java.util.zip.CRC32();\n        crc.update(bin, 12, hashLen + (1 << p));\n        long v = crc.getValue();\n        bin[8] = (byte) (v >>> 24);\n        bin[9] = (byte) (v >>> 16);\n        bin[10] = (byte) (v >>> 8);\n        bin[11] = (byte) v;\n        return bin;\n    }\n\n    private   Map<String, Object> base = SketchJsonCodec.toJson(populated(12));\n\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(null), \"null JSON 草图\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m1 = new     m3.put(\"precision\", 19);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m3), \"precision=19\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m4 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m4.put(\"registerCount\", 100);\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m4), \"registerCount 与 precision 矛盾\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m5 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m5.put(\"registersBase64\", \"!!!not-base64!!!\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m5), \"非法 Base64\");\n\n        // Base64 合法但字节数不对\n        Map<String, Object> m6 = new      // 寄存器越界（长度恰好 4096，构造 rank=54）\n        byte[] regs = new byte[4096];\n        regs[0] = 54;\n        Map<String, Object> m7 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m7.put(\"registersBase64\", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(regs));\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m7), \"JSON 寄存器 rank=54 越界\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> m8 = new LinkedHashMap<>(base);\n        m8.remove(\"hashId\");\n        expectBadFormat(() -> SketchJsonCodec.fromJson(m8), \"缺 hashId\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectBadFormat(Runnable r, String what) {\n dev.dedup.hll;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 查询引擎 JSON 端到端：正常批处理、错误码、合并、导出导入、坏 JSON、估计标注。 */\npublic class QueryEngineTest extends TestCase {\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"查询引擎 JSON 端到端（算子/错误处理/估计标注）\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() throws Exception {\n        testBasicLifecycle();\n        testShardMergeViaJson();\n        testExportImportFormats();\n        testErrorCases();\n        testEstimateLabeling();\n        testMalformedJson();\n        testPlanPresent();\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private Map<String, Object> run(String json) {\n        return new QueryEngine().execute((Map<String, Object>) Json.parse(json));\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private Map<String, Object> resultAt(Map<String, Object> resp, int i) {\n        return (Map<String, Object>) ((List<?>) resp.get(\"results\")).get(i);\n    }\n\n    private void testBasicLifecycle() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(\"{\"\n                + \"\\\"ops\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"uv\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12},\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"add\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"uv\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"c\\\",1,2,true,null,\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\"]}\"\n                + \"]}\");\n        eq(resp.get(\"ok\"), true, \"create+add 成功\");\n        // a/b/c/1/2/true/null = 7 个不同类型元素；a,b 重复\n        Map<String, Object> est = run(\"{\"\n                + \"\\\"ops\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"uv\\\",\\\"precision\\\":14},\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"add\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"uv\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"c\\\",1,2,true,null,\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\"]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"estimate\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"uv\\\"}\"\n                + \"]}\");\n        Map<String, Object> estResult = resultAt(est, 2);\n        long card = ((Number) estResult.get(\"cardinalityEstimate\")).longValue();\n        check(card >= 6 && card <= 9, \"7 个跨类型去重元素估计在 6..9，实际 \" + card);\n        eq(estResult.get(\"exact\"), false, \"exact 必须显式为 false\");\n        check(estResult.get(\"estimationNote\") != null, \"必须有人读的估计说明\");\n    }\n\n    private void testShardMergeViaJson() {\n        // 两个分片各含 0..999 与其后的 1000..1999，部分重叠\n        List<String> ops = new ArrayList<>();\n        ops.add(\"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"s1\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12}\");\n        ops.add(\"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"s2\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12}\");\n        ops.add(\"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"total\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12}\");\n ops.add(\"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"s2\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12}\");\n        ops.add(\"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"total\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12}\");\n \"\").append(\"\\\"u\").append(i).append(\"\\\"\");\n        }\n        for (int i = 1000; i < 3000; i++) {\n            v2.append(i > 1000 ? \",\" : 输出：results/error-distribution/report.json 与 report.md（命令行参数可覆盖）。\n */\npublic final class ErrorDistributionMain {\n\n    static final long BASE_SEED = 20260922L;\n    static final int PRECISION = 12;\n    static final int SHARDS = 4;\n    static final long[] CARDINALITIES = {100L, 1_000L, 100_000L, 1_000_000L};\n    static final int TRIALS = 20;\n\n    private ErrorDistributionMain() {\n    }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {\n        String outDir = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : \"results/error-distribution\";\n        Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(outDir));\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> groups = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (long n : CARDINALITIES) {\n            groups.add(runGroup(n));\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        report.put(\"report\", \"HLL error distribution (fixed seeds, deterministic)\");\n        report.put(\"hashAlgorithm\", Map<String, Object> setup = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        setup.put(\"precision\", PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"registerCount\", 1 << PRECISION);\n        setup.put(\"theoreticalRse\", setup.put(\"shardsPerTrial\", SHARDS);\n        setup.put(\"trialSeedRule\", \"Random(20260922 + trialIndex)，顺序产出 n 个 64 位 h1\");\n        report.put(\"setup\", setup);\n        report.put(\"groups\", {"parentUuid":"57c0841d-b81f-4407-a392-ae33e806ddff","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_l354g5pufgabvs19a3lpfi4i","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/b/README.md","content":"# 可合并近似去重引擎（HyperLogLog，纯后端）\n\n单机内存的**近似基数（去重计数）**查询引擎，JSON 文件为请求入口。\n核心运算全部自行实现，**不使用任何 SQL 引擎或第三方基数库**（连 JSON 解析都是自研的零依赖实现）。\n草图（sketch）与执行计划均可导出/导入，支持多分片合并。无任何前端代码。\n\n> ⚠️ **关于“计数”的性质**：本系统输出的一切去重数字都是 HyperLogLog 的**估计值（estimate）**，\n> 不是精确计数。响应中始终带 `\"exact\": false`、相对标准误差（RSE）和名义置信区间。\n> 只有空集（估计为 0）在语义上是确定的。HLL 不保存原始元素，无法回溯精确集合。\n\n## 1. 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/main/java/dev/dedup/hll/\n  Murmur3Hash128.java       固定哈希：MurmurHash3 x64_128（固定种子，只用 h1）\n  HllConfig.java            精度 p + 哈希标识，不可变配置与兼容性检查\n  HllSketch.java            HLL 草图：插入、估计、逐寄存器 max 合并\n  BinarySketchCodec.java    紧凑二进制格式（魔数/版本/CRC32/严格校验）\n  SketchJsonCodec.java      可移植 JSON 草图格式\n  ValueCanonicalizer.java   JSON 值 -> 带类型标签的确定性字节\n  Json.java                 零依赖 JSON 解析器/写入器\n  QueryEngine.java          内存查询引擎：顺序执行算子、错误处理、执行计划\n  Main.java                 CLI：java dev.dedup.hll.Main [request.json]\n  ErrorDistributionMain.java 固定种子多基数误差分布实验\nsrc/test/java/dev/dedup/hll/  零依赖测试框架 + 4 个测试类（26 万+ 断言）\nsamples/requests/             5 个请求样例\nsamples/responses/            实际运行得到的响应 + 执行计划\nresults/hash_kat_reference.py 独立 Python 哈希参考实现（KAT 向量生成器）\nresults/hash-kat-vectors.json 哈希已知答案向量\nresults/error-distribution/   误差分布报告（json + md，固定种子可复现）\nbuild.sh / test.sh / run-samples.sh / run-error-distribution.sh\n```\n\n## 2. 算法与固定参数（版本内不可更改）\n\n| 项目 | 取值 |\n|---|---|\n| 哈希算法 | MurmurHash3 **x64 128-bit**（Austin Appleby 公有领域实现） |\n| 种子 | **固定** `0x9747B28C`（不接受调用方覆盖） |\n| 消费位 | 仅用 128 位输出的低 64 位 **h1** |\n| 算法标识串 | `MURMUR3_X64_128_SEED9747B28C_H1`（写入序列化格式并参与兼容性检查） |\n| 精度 p | 4..18，寄存器数 m=2^p，草图固定占用 m 字节 |\n| 索引/rank | h1 高 p 位为寄存器索引；剩余位 `rank = clz((h1<<p)|1<<(p-1))+1`，范围 1..65-p |\n| 合并 | 同配置草图逐寄存器取最大 rank（天然支持分片重叠，幂等、可交换、可结合） |\n| 基数估计 | 小基数线性计数 `m·ln(m/V)`（阈值 raw≤2.5m 且有零寄存器）；否则调和平均 α·m²/Σ2^-R |\n| 理论误差 | 经典相对标准误差 RSE ≈ 1.04/√m。p=12 时 m=4096，**RSE ≈ 1.625%** |\n\n**有意未实现并如实声明**：HLL++ 的经验偏差修正（empirical bias correction）与大基数量程修正。\n本实现用经典线性计数覆盖小基数区间；不做偏差修正对 p≥10 的常规使用影响很小，\n但在极小基数/极低精度下与 HLL++ 调优实现会有差异。64 位哈希下大基数量程修正无实际意义，故省略。\n\n### 值的规范化（为什么字符串 \"1\" 和数字 1 不会被当成同一个）\n\n插入前先加 **1 字节类型标签**再哈希：\n\n| JSON 值 | 规范化字节 |\n|---|---|\n| `null` | `00` |\n| `false` / `true` | `01` / `02` |\n| 整数 | `03` + 十进制 ASCII（如 `1`、`-3`） |\n| 浮点 | `04` + `BigDecimal.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()`（`1.0`、`1.00`、`1e2` 规范化一致） |\n| 字符串 | `05` + UTF-8 字节 |\n\n对象和数组不允许作为去重元素（直接报错），避免定义不清的序列化歧义。\n\n## 3. 构建与测试（零依赖，仅需 JDK）\n\n开发环境为 OpenJDK 21（代码使用 Java 8 级 API，未依赖 21 特性）。\n\n```bash\n./build.sh                    # 编译到 build/classes\n./test.sh                     # 编译 + 运行全部自动化测试\n./run-samples.sh              # 跑 samples/ 下请求，响应写入 samples/responses/\n./run-error-distribution.sh   # 固定种子误差实验 -> results/error-distribution/\n```\n\n手工方式：\n\n```bash\nfind src/main/java -name '*.java' > /tmp/src.txt\njavac -encoding UTF-8 -d build/classes @/tmp/src.txt\njava -cp build/classes dev.dedup.hll.Main samples/requests/01-basic-add-estimate.json\n```\n\n## 4. JSON 请求协议\n\n顶层 `{\"ops\":[ ... ]}`，算子在数组中**顺序执行**，草图保存在内存 Map。\n某个算子失败则在该算子处中止，返回 `ok=false`、错误码与 `failedOpIndex`（之前算子已生效）。\n\n| 算子 | 必填字段 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `create` | `name`,`precision` | 新建空草图 |\n| `add` | `name`,`values` | 规范化 + 固定哈希 + 更新寄存器（重复幂等） |\n| `add-hash` | `name`,`hashes` | 直接注入 64 位 h1（十进制或 `0x..`），供确定性测试 |\n| `merge` | `name`,`sources`(≥2) | 兼容性检查通过后逐寄存器 max；源可重叠 |\n| `estimate` | `name` | 返回估计值、`exact:false`、RSE、68%/95% 区间、零寄存器数 |\n| `export` | `name`,`format` | `binary`（Base64 的 HLCD v1）或 `json`（HLL-JSON v1） |\n| `load` | `name`,`format` | 与 export 对应，严格校验后载入内存 |\n| `list` | — | 列出内存中草图（配置/命中寄存器数，不含估计） |\n\n响应固定包含 `ok / opsProcessed / results / executionPlan / metadata`，\n其中 `executionPlan` 是可读的执行计划（每步算子与实际行为描述），也可用 CLI 的\n`--plan-out 文件` 单独导出。\n\n### 错误码\n\n| code | 触发条件 |\n|---|---|\n| `MALFORMED_JSON` | 请求读不懂（JSON 语法错误、顶层非对象），CLI 退出码 2 |\n| `INVALID_REQUEST` | 缺字段、精度越界、空 values、未知导出格式等 |\n| `UNKNOWN_OP` | 无法识别的算子 |\n| `SKETCH_NOT_FOUND` / `SKETCH_EXISTS` | 草图不存在 / 重名创建 |\n| `INCOMPATIBLE_SKETCH` | 合并双方 **p 或 hashId 不一致**（拒绝合并且不修改任何草图） |\n| `BAD_FORMAT` | 导入草图魔数/版本/长度/寄存器值域/标志位/**CRC32** 任一校验失败 |\n\nCLI 退出码：`0` 成功；`1` 业务错误（响应 `ok=false`）；`2` 请求无法读取/解析。\n\n## 5. 二进制草图格式（HLCD v1，大端序）\n\n```\n偏移  长度 字段\n0     4   魔数 'H' 'L' 'C' 'D'\n4     1   版本 = 1\n5     1   精度 p（4..18）\n6     1   哈希标识字节长度 L（1..255）\n7     1   标志位（v1 必须为 0）\n8     4   CRC32，对偏移 12 之后全部字节计算\n12    L   哈希标识 UTF-8（内容即固定算法+种子串）\n12+L  m   m=2^p 个寄存器字节，值域 0..(65-p)\n```\n\n合并的**配置一致性**要求（见 `HllConfig.incompatibilityReason`）：\n\n1. 精度 p 必须相同（寄存器数不同无法逐位合并）；\n2. 哈希标识必须相同（不同哈希算法/种子下同一值映射到不同桶，合并结果无意义）。\n\n不做静默降精度、不做重哈希；不一致直接 `INCOMPATIBLE_SKETCH`。\n\n## 6. 请求样例\n\n| 文件 | 演示内容 | 退出码 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `01-basic-add-estimate.json` | 建草图、重复值/跨类型插入、估计 | 0 |\n| `02-shard-merge.json` | 3 个地域分片（含重叠用户）合并为全局 UV | 0 |\n| `03-incompatible-merge.json` | p=12 与 p=10 草图合并被拒绝 | 1（预期） |\n| `04-export-binary-json.json` | 同一草图导出二进制与 JSON 两种格式 | 0 |\n| `05-load-bad-binary.json` | 载入被翻转 1 字节的草图，CRC32 拦截 | 1（预期） |\n\n样例响应是在本机**实际运行产物**，见 `samples/responses/*.response.json` 与 `*.plan.json`。\n典型用法（也支持从 stdin 读请求）：\n\n```bash\njava -cp build/classes dev.dedup.hll.Main samples/requests/02-shard-merge.json\ncat request.json | java -cp build/classes dev.dedup.hll.Main --compact --plan-out plan.json\n```\n\n## 7. 实测结果（如实记录，详见 [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md)）\n\n- 自动化测试：**4/4 测试类、266 657 项断言全部通过**，覆盖空集、重复插入幂等、\n  4 分片合并不差 1 个寄存器、不兼容配置拒绝、9 类二进制坏格式与 8 类 JSON 坏格式。\n- 固定哈希：Java 实现与独立 Python 移植版在 10 组 KAT 向量上 h1/h2 **逐向量一致**。\n- 误差分布（p=12，每组 20 个固定种子试验，4 分片）：n=1000/100000/1000000 的\n  样本标准差约 1.3%~1.6%，与理论 RSE 1.625% 吻合；**n=10000 这一组抽到波动偏大的种子集\n  （std 3.13%）**，经独立 Python 版 HLL 复算确认是小样本抽样波动而非实现缺陷（详见 RESULTS.md）。\n- 全部 4 分片合并试验中，合并草图与整体草图逐寄存器**完全一致（0 次不一致）**。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_a96d0efec2aed3b13b6e641d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1116,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":96056,"output_tokens":2933,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_l354g5pufgabvs19a3lpfi4i":{"content":"# 算法与固定参数（版本内不可更改）\n\n| 项目 | 取值 |\n|---|---|\n| 哈希算法 | MurmurHash3 **x64 128-bit**（Austin Appleby 公有领域实现） |\n| 种子 | **固定** `0x9747B28C`（不接受调用方覆盖） |\n| 消费位 | 仅用 128 位输出的低 64 位 **h1** |\n| 算法标识串 | `MURMUR3_X64_128_SEED9747B28C_H1`（写入序列化格式并参与兼容性检查） |\n| 精度 p | 4..18，寄存器数 m=2^p，草图固定占用 m 字节 |\n| 索引/rank | h1 高 p 位为寄存器索引；剩余位 `rank = clz((h1<<p)|1<<(p-1))+1`，范围 1..65-p |\n| 合并 | 同配置草图逐寄存器取最大 rank（天然支持分片重叠，幂等、可交换、可结合） |\n| 基数估计 | 小基数线性计数 `m·ln(m/V)`（阈值 raw≤2.5m 且有零寄存器）；否则调和平均 α·m²/Σ2^-R |\n| 理论误差 | 经典相对标准误差 RSE ≈ 1.04/√m。p=12 时 m=4096，**RSE ≈ 1.625%** |\n\n**有意未实现并如实声明**：HLL++ 的经验偏差修正（empirical bias correction）与大基数量程修正。\n本实现用经典线性计数覆盖小基数区间；不做偏差修正对 p≥10 的常规使用影响很小，\n但在极小基数/极低精度下与 HLL++ 调优实现会有差异。64 位哈希下大基数量程修正无实际意义，故省略。\n\n### 值的规范化（为什么字符串 \"1\" 和数字 1 不会被当成同一个）\n\n插入前先加 **1 字节类型标签**再哈希：\n\n| JSON 值 | 规范化字节 |\n|---|---|\n| `null` | `00` |\n| `false` / `true` | `01` / `02` |\n| 整数 | `03` + 十进制 ASCII（如 `1`、`-3`） |\n| 浮点 | `04` + `BigDecimal.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()`（`1.0`、`1.00`、`1e2` 规范化一致） |\n| 字符串 | `05` + UTF-8 字节 |\n\n对象和数组不允许作为去重元素（直接报错），避免定义不清的序列化歧义。\n\n## 3. 构建与测试（零依赖，仅需 JDK）\n\n开发环境为 OpenJDK 21（代码使用 Java 8 级 API，未依赖 21 特性）。\n\n```bash\n./build.sh                    # 编译到 build/classes\n./test.sh                     # 编译 + 运行全部自动化测试\n./run-samples.sh              # 跑 samples/ 下请求，响应写入 samples/responses/\n./run-error-distribution.sh   # 固定种子误差实验 -> results/error-distribution/\n```\n\n手工方式：\n\n```bash\nfind src/main/java -name '*.java' > /tmp/src.txt\njavac -encoding UTF-8 -d build/classes @/tmp/src.txt\njava -cp build/classes dev.dedup.hll.Main samples/requests/01-basic-add-estimate.json\n```\n\n## 4. JSON 请求协议\n\n顶层 `{\"ops\":[ ... ]}`，算子在数组中**顺序执行**，草图保存在内存 Map。\n某个算子失败则在该算子处中止，返回 `ok=false`、错误码与 `failedOpIndex`（之前算子已生效）。\n\n| 算子 | 必填字段 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `create` | `name`,`precision` | 新建空草图 |\n| `add` | `name`,`values` | 规范化 + 固定哈希 + 更新寄存器（重复幂等） |\n| `add-hash` | `name`,`hashes` | 直接注入 64 位 h1（十进制或 `0x..`），供确定性测试 |\n| `merge` | `name`,`sources`(≥2) | 兼容性检查通过后逐寄存器 max；源可重叠 |\n| `estimate` | `name` | 返回估计值、`exact:false`、RSE、68%/95% 区间、零寄存器数 |\n| `export` | `name`,`format` | `binary`（Base64 的 HLCD v1）或 `json`（HLL-JSON v1） |\n| `load` | `name`,`format` | 与 export 对应，严格校验后载入内存 |\n| `list` | — | 列出内存中草图（配置/命中寄存器数，不含估计） |\n\n响应固定包含 `ok / opsProcessed / results / executionPlan / metadata`，\n其中 `executionPlan` 是可读的执行计划（每步算子与实际行为描述），也可用 CLI 的\n`--plan-out 文件` 单独导出。\n\n### 错误码\n\n| code | 触发条件 |\n|---|---|\n| `MALFORMED_JSON` | 请求读不懂（JSON 语法错误、顶层非对象），CLI 退出码 2 |\n| `INVALID_REQUEST` | 缺字段、精度越界、空 values、未知导出格式等 |\n| `UNKNOWN_OP` | 无法识别的算子 |\n| `SKETCH_NOT_FOUND` / `SKETCH_EXISTS` | 草图不存在 / 重名创建 |\n| `INCOMPATIBLE_SKETCH` | 合并双方 **p 或 hashId 不一致**（拒绝合并且不修改任何草图） |\n| `BAD_FORMAT` | 导入草图魔数/版本/长度/寄存器值域/标志位/**CRC32** 任一校验失败 |\n\nCLI 退出码：`0` 成功；`1` 业务错误（响应 `ok=false`）；`2` 请求无法读取/解析。\n\n## 5. 二进制草图格式（HLCD v1，大端序）\n\n```\n偏移  长度 字段\n0     4   魔数 'H' 'L' 'C' 'D'\n4     1   版本 = 1\n5     1   精度 p（4..18）\n6     1   哈希标识字节长度 L（1..255）\n7     1   标志位（v1 必须为 0）\n8     4   CRC32，对偏移 12 之后全部字节计算\n12    L   哈希标识 UTF-8（内容即固定算法+种子串）\n12+L  m   m=2^p 个寄存器字节，值域 0..(65-p)\n```\n\n合并的**配置一致性**要求（见 `HllConfig.incompatibilityReason`）：\n\n1. 精度 p 必须相同（寄存器数不同无法逐位合并）；\n2. 哈希标识必须相同（不同哈希算法/种子下同一值映射到不同桶，合并结果无意义）。\n\n不做静默降精度、不做重哈希；不一致直接 `INCOMPATIBLE_SKETCH`。\n\n## 6. 请求样例\n\n| 文件 | 演示内容 | 退出码 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `01-basic-add-estimate.json` | m=4096\ndef both(regs):\n    z=regs.count(0); s=sum(2.0**(-r) for r in regs); raw=0.7213/(1+1.079/m)*m*m/s\n    lin=m*math.log(m/z) if z>0 else float('nan')\n    return raw, lin, z\nnl=nraw=0; rawrels=[];
